mechanism: Amiodarone inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, significantly increasing phenelzine exposure and serotonergic activity, while both drugs prolong QT interval and phenelzine's MAOI activity creates risk of hypertensive crisis and serotonin syndrome.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if absolutely necessary, use lowest doses with intensive cardiac monitoring, blood pressure monitoring, and patient education on serotonergic food/drug interactions.
